title: OBD Memorial — Israel Grigoryevich Berman

title: Grigory Sherel’s service and awards
note: Transfer list for Tbilisi of 8 January 1943, award recommendation and 18th Army order of 10 September 1944, and award document No. 425 of 5 May 1945.

note: Recommendation sheet for the medal «За боевые заслуги», dated 16–17 July 1945.
